obligation.anchor: The system shall offer users the ability to pause data refresh.
obligation.contradiction: The system shall not offer users the ability to pause data refresh.
obligation.entailment: Users must be able to temporarily stop the automatic refresh of displayed data.
obligation.neutral: Users shall be able to choose the interval used for automatic data refresh.

obligation.anchor: The product shall operate in offline mode when the internet connection is unavailable.
obligation.contradiction: The product shall not operate in offline mode when the internet connection is unavailable.
obligation.entailment: If internet access is lost, the product must work in its offline mode.
obligation.neutral: When the internet connection is unavailable, the product shall display a network status icon.

obligation.contradiction: The case history shall omit every action that modifies an existing dispute case.
obligation.entailment: The case history must log every action that changes an existing dispute case.

obligation.anchor: The product may connect to the Choice Parts System to receive recycled parts data.
obligation.contradiction: The product may not connect to the Choice Parts System to receive recycled parts data.
obligation.entailment: It is permissible for the product to obtain recycled parts data by connecting to the Choice Parts System.
obligation.neutral: The product shall display the supplier name for each recycled part.

obligation.anchor: The product shall be able to send meeting reminders to employees.
obligation.contradiction: The product must not be able to send meeting reminders to employees.
obligation.entailment: The product must support sending employees reminder messages about meetings.
obligation.neutral: The product shall let employees view past meeting invitations.

obligation.anchor: The system must encrypt all credit card information in the database.
obligation.contradiction: The system must leave every credit card detail in the database unencrypted.
obligation.entailment: Every credit card detail stored in the database must be encrypted.

obligation.contradiction: All network transactions that involve financial information or personally identifiable information shall never be encrypted.
obligation.entailment: Network transactions must be encrypted whenever they carry financial data or data identifying a person.
obligation.neutral: Network transactions that carry financial information must be acknowledged in a receipt.

obligation.anchor: Users may change their own passwords.
obligation.contradiction: Users are prohibited from changing their own passwords.
obligation.entailment: Users are permitted to choose a new password for their own account.
obligation.neutral: Users may view the date of their last password change.

role.anchor: Only registered realtors may access the system.
role.contradiction: Unregistered realtors may access the system.
role.entailment: Access to the system is restricted to realtors who are registered.
role.neutral: Registered realtors may update their contact details in the system.

role.anchor: Only program administrators or members of the nursing staff may access clinical site details.
role.contradiction: Students who are neither program administrators nor nursing staff may access clinical site details.
role.entailment: Access to clinical site details is restricted to people in program administration or on the nursing staff.

role.anchor: Only users with Update access may initiate dispute requests.
role.contradiction: Users without Update access may initiate dispute requests.
role.entailment: Initiating a dispute request is permitted exclusively for users holding Update access.
role.neutral: Users without Update access may read an existing dispute request.

role.anchor: Only the system administrator may reset a revoked user logon account.
role.contradiction: A help desk agent who is not a system administrator may reset a revoked user logon account.
role.entailment: Resetting revoked user logon accounts is a privilege reserved for the system administrator.
role.neutral: The help desk may receive a notice when a user logon account is revoked.

role.anchor: Only registered customers may purchase streaming movies.
role.contradiction: Customers may purchase streaming movies without registering.
role.entailment: Purchasing a streaming movie is reserved for customers who have registered.
role.neutral: Unregistered visitors may browse the streaming movie catalog.

role.anchor: Only authorized personnel may access sales information.
role.contradiction: Personnel without authorization may access sales information.
role.entailment: Access to sales information is limited to staff with authorization.

role.anchor: Only the commissioner of a league may adjust that league's settings.
role.contradiction: Regular members who are not commissioners may adjust their league's settings.
role.entailment: Changes to a league's settings may be made exclusively by its commissioner.
role.neutral: League members may read the current league settings.

role.anchor: Only users authorized for home access to the corporate intranet may use COS from outside company sites.
role.contradiction: Users without home-access authorization may use COS from outside company sites.
role.entailment: Off-site use of COS is restricted to users with authorization to access the corporate intranet from home.
role.neutral: Off-site COS users must follow the corporate inactivity timeout.

numeric.anchor: The Disputes application shall have a capacity of at least 350 concurrent users at normal performance.
numeric.contradiction: The Disputes application shall have a capacity of at most 250 concurrent users at normal performance.
numeric.entailment: The Disputes application must handle 350 or more users simultaneously without slowing down.
numeric.neutral: The Disputes application shall display the number of concurrent users in an administrator view.

numeric.anchor: The product must maintain uptime of at least 98 percent of scheduled operating time.
numeric.contradiction: The product must maintain uptime of less than 95 percent of scheduled operating time.
numeric.entailment: The product shall be available for no less than 98 percent of its scheduled operating time.
numeric.neutral: The product must notify an administrator when it goes offline.

numeric.anchor: Each customer installation must remain operational for at least 5 years.
numeric.contradiction: Every customer installation shall be shut down permanently by its third anniversary.
numeric.entailment: The installed product must keep working for each customer for a minimum of five years.

numeric.anchor: The product shall be installable within 2 days in every operating environment.
numeric.contradiction: Installing the product in any operating environment must take at least three days.
numeric.entailment: Installation of the product must be possible in no more than two days regardless of the operating environment.
numeric.neutral: For each operating environment, the product shall provide an installation log.

numeric.anchor: Each streaming server must have a capacity of at most 700 movies.
numeric.contradiction: Each streaming server must have a capacity of at least 900 movies.
numeric.entailment: A single streaming server's movie capacity shall be capped at seven hundred.
numeric.neutral: The streaming server shall support searching for a movie by title.

numeric.anchor: For the Izogn administrator, website category listing updates must take at most 2 minutes.
numeric.contradiction: For the Izogn administrator, website category listing updates must take at least 4 minutes.
numeric.entailment: On the website, updating the category listings must take the Izogn administrator no longer than two minutes.

numeric.anchor: The application must complete each network transaction within 0.25 seconds of receiving it.
numeric.contradiction: The application shall wait at least 0.5 seconds after receiving each network transaction before completing it.
numeric.entailment: Every transaction received over the network must finish within one quarter of a second after arrival.
numeric.neutral: The application must log a timestamp when it receives a network transaction.

numeric.contradiction: A waiter password used for tablet login must have a bit-strength of at most 32 bits.
numeric.entailment: Waiters' tablet login passwords must provide 64 bits or more of strength.
numeric.neutral: Waiters must re-enter their passwords to unlock a sleeping tablet.

action.contradiction: The product shall permanently discard all saved user preferences in the event of a failure.
action.entailment: Saved user preferences must survive a product failure.
action.neutral: In the event of a failure, the product shall display its error code.

action.anchor: The User Report shall record all new user additions and all changes to users' access.
action.contradiction: The User Report shall omit all new user additions and all changes to users' access.
action.entailment: Every addition of a new user and every alteration of user access must appear on the User Report.
action.neutral: The User Report shall be sortable by date.

action.anchor: The adjuster shall be able to override the preferred repair facility on an estimate assignment.
action.contradiction: The preferred repair facility on an estimate assignment must be locked against edits by the adjuster.
action.entailment: When assigning an estimate, the adjuster must be able to replace the default preferred repair facility.

action.anchor: The system shall restore business data from backups on demand.
action.contradiction: Whenever restoration of business data is requested, the system must discard the backup without restoring the data.
action.entailment: When asked, the system must recover business data from its backup copies.
action.neutral: The system shall record the date of the latest backup.

action.anchor: The system shall let an administrator deactivate a customer account in under one minute.
action.contradiction: The system must reject every administrator request to deactivate a customer account and keep the account active.
action.entailment: An administrator must be able to disable a customer's account in less than sixty seconds.
action.neutral: The site shall let an administrator download a list of inactive customer accounts.

action.anchor: The website shall alert the administrator at every occurrence of intentional abuse.
action.contradiction: The website shall suppress alerts to the administrator for every occurrence of intentional abuse.
action.entailment: The administrator must be notified of each intentional abuse incident on the website.

action.anchor: After a missed shot, the player who took the shot shall be defensive for the next turn.
action.contradiction: After a missed shot, the player who took the shot shall keep offensive status for the next turn.
action.entailment: A player whose shot misses must switch to defense on the following turn.
action.neutral: After a missed shot, the product shall add a miss to the player's statistics.

action.anchor: The system shall keep a record of every completed customer payment transaction.
action.contradiction: The system must discard the record of every completed customer payment and retain no copy.
action.entailment: A record of each customer payment must be retained once the transaction is complete.
action.neutral: The system must email customers a receipt when a payment transaction completes.

condition.anchor: The system shall notify the realtor of every new client appointment received through automatic office synchronization.
condition.contradiction: The system shall alert the realtor only for manually entered new appointments and shall suppress alerts for synchronized ones.
condition.entailment: Whenever an automatic sync with the office system imports a new client appointment, the realtor must be told.
condition.neutral: The system shall provide a weekly count of appointments imported by office synchronization.

condition.anchor: Playback may buffer only when a user's connection exceeds its latency threshold.
condition.contradiction: Playback shall buffer whenever a user's connection is below its latency threshold.
condition.entailment: Playback buffering is permitted solely when latency on the user's connection is above the limit.
condition.neutral: Playback must reduce video resolution when a user's connection exceeds its latency threshold.

condition.anchor: The website shall stay online during payment gateway outages.
condition.contradiction: The website shall be taken offline during every payment gateway outage.
condition.entailment: Even if the payment gateway fails, the website must remain available.
condition.neutral: The website shall stop accepting card payments during payment gateway outages.

condition.anchor: If a lead takes more than 25 seconds to process, the system shall record the event and its duration.
condition.contradiction: The system shall record lead events and their durations only for leads processed in 25 seconds or less.
condition.entailment: The system must log each lead processing event and how long it took whenever it exceeds twenty-five seconds.
condition.neutral: The system shall forward leads that take more than 25 seconds to a manual review queue.

condition.anchor: On a 56 kbps connection, at least 90 percent of responses must complete within 6 seconds.
condition.contradiction: On a 56 kbps connection, the application shall delay every response until 10 seconds have elapsed.
condition.entailment: On a 56 kbps link, nine in ten responses or more must finish in no more than six seconds.
condition.neutral: On a 112 kbps connection, at least 90 percent of responses must complete within 3 seconds.

condition.anchor: The system must make all of its functions available whenever it is powered on.
condition.contradiction: The system must block access to all of its functions whenever it is powered on.
condition.entailment: When the system is on, users must be able to use every function.

condition.anchor: After a crash or power loss, the system shall recover its previous state.
condition.contradiction: After a crash or power loss, the system shall start from a blank state and abandon its previous state.
condition.entailment: The system must return to its pre-failure state if it crashes or loses power.
condition.neutral: After a crash or power loss, the system shall notify an operator.

condition.anchor: When ECA has a malfunction, the system shall warn every ECA user.
condition.contradiction: The system shall show warnings only when ECA is healthy and suppress them throughout any malfunction.
condition.entailment: All ECA users must receive a warning from the system if ECA malfunctions.
condition.neutral: When ECA has a malfunction, the system must write a diagnostic record.
